data.name: Vaidehi
data.gender_notes: Vaidehi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Videha, the kingdom of Sita's father — Vaidehī, 'princess of Videha'. Its root is Sanskrit videha (विदेह). An epithet of Sita in the Ramayana. Vaidehi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Of Videha; Sita”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vaidehi expresses “Of Videha; Sita”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Videha, the kingdom of Sita's father — Vaidehī, 'princess of Videha'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vaidehi total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

data.cultural_impact: Vaidehi is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Of Videha; Sita”.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Of Videha; Sita” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Vaidehi; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the name of the queen of King Janaka in the Mahabharata, Vaidehi was the mother of Lord Rama and Queen Sita.

historical_references.reference: An epithet of Sita in the Ramayana.
